low-light.purpose: The unlit page, and the recessed fill inside inputs. Also the text color on any filled accent button.

lamp-surface.purpose: Cards, panels, the primary content plane. The paper under the lamp.

lit-edge.purpose: Nested detail. Wells holding desglose line items sit here, so a breakdown reads as inside its card rather than as another card.

bone-dim.purpose: Secondary text, labels, supporting copy. 8.6:1 on Low Light.

bone-faint.purpose: The quietest legible ink: timestamps, placeholders, disabled captions, the select chevron. 4.52:1 against Lit Edge is the tightest pair in the system.

hairline.purpose: Decorative separation. Card and well borders, usually at 50-60% opacity. Deliberately quieter than the interactive edge.

hairline-strong.purpose: Interactive edges: input, select, and secondary-button borders. Tuned to land exactly on 3.00:1 against Lamp Surface.

clear-green.purpose: Money in. Income amounts, confirmed states, completed savings targets. Never decorative.

warm-alarm.purpose: Money out. Expense amounts, destructive actions, deletion confirmations.

held-amber.purpose: Pending or unresolved. Uncommitted entries, over-budget warnings, anything waiting on the user.

lamp-arena.purpose: Default accent. The quietest of the five: a warm near-neutral that reads as part of the room rather than as a highlight.

lamp-emerald.purpose: Accent variant. Shifted to hue 160 so it stays distinguishable from Clear Green at 158 on the same screen.

lamp-sky.purpose: Accent variant. The only cool accent; the one escape from the warm shell.

lamp-amber.purpose: Accent variant. The literal lamp reading: warmest and brightest of the five.

lamp-rose.purpose: Accent variant. Parked at hue 356, not 15, so a rose-themed heading is never mistaken for an expense amount.

display.purpose: The single headline balance figure. Two occurrences in the whole app; the scarcity is what makes it read as the answer.

headline.purpose: Section titles via .heading, rendered in the active accent. The one place accent and type meet.

title.purpose: Card titles, list-group headers, form section labels.

body.purpose: The dominant size. Most UI text, list rows, form copy. Weight 380, a step below regular, because light-on-dark renders optically heavier.

label.purpose: Metadata, timestamps, category tags, helper text. Always Bone Dim or Bone Faint.

amount.purpose: Every monetary figure, monospaced without exception. Tabular figures make columns scan vertically and stop digits shifting as values update.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Marks what leaves the page plane: active nav item, modal, toast, dropdown. Never on a resting surface.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Press feedback and hover transitions. Motion conveys state, never decoration.

motion.name: duration-transition
motion.purpose: Disclosure and larger state changes. Upper bound; nothing runs longer.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: The only motion in the button vocabulary. Applied on :active to every button.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all animations and transitions collapse globally.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Card padding grows 1.25rem -> 1.5rem; headings step up to 1.5rem.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Card padding reaches 2rem. The desktop review surface trades density for air.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committing action on a screen. Filled with the user's active accent; text drops to Low Light so it reads on any of the five.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-app); color: var(--bg-app); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-app); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The non-committing sibling. Fill never changes; only the border moves to the accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface-app); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 380; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent-app); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-app); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions read as destructive before they are clicked: soft alarm tint at rest, solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--negative) 14%, var(--surface-app)); color: var(--negative); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 380; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--negative) 32%, var(--surface-app)); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--negative); color: var(--bg-app); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-app); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Fully round, translucent, quiet at rest. Glyph and border both move to the accent on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Editar"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--surface-app) 50%, transparent); color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.625rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { color: var(--accent-app); border-color: var(--accent-app); background: var(--bg-app); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-app); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The primary content plane. Flat by doctrine: depth comes from the lightness step, not a shadow. Full hairline border, never a side stripe.
components.html:
Gastos del mes

− $12,480.00

18 movimientos · agosto
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface-app); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border-app) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem; overflow: hidden; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-card { padding: 1.5rem; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-card { padding: 2rem; } } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-card-amount { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--negative); } .ds-card-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Well (nested breakdown)
components.description: Signature component. Desglose line items sit on Lit Edge inside a card, so detail reads as nested without becoming a second card. A card inside a card is always wrong; this is the correct answer.
components.css: .ds-well { background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border-app) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 380; color: var(--text-secondary); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-well-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; } .ds-well-amt { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A field is a recess, not a raised object: it fills with Low Light, one step below the card it sits on. Focus moves border and ring to the accent.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg-app); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 380; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-app); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-app); }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Inline feedback in three fixed flavors. Soft 14% tint, full 32% border on all four sides. Side stripes are prohibited.
components.html: No se pudo guardar el gasto. Revisa el monto.
components.css: .ds-notice { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; } .ds-notice-negative { color: var(--negative); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--negative) 14%, var(--surface-app)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--negative) 32%, var(--surface-app)); } .ds-notice-positive { color: var(--positive); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--positive) 14%, var(--surface-app)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--positive) 32%, var(--surface-app)); } .ds-notice-warning { color: var(--warning); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 14%, var(--surface-app)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 32%, var(--surface-app)); }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Small round pill marking an unresolved amount. Monospace label so it aligns with the figure it annotates.
components.html: Pendiente
components.css: .ds-tag-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--warning); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 14%, var(--surface-app)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--warning) 32%, var(--surface-app)); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Navigation Tabs
components.description: Tab-based navigation. The active item takes the accent and the one legal shadow in the system; inactive items are Bone Dim with no fill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--accent-app); color: var(--bg-app); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-nav-item-active:hover { background: var(--accent-app); color: var(--bg-app); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-app); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
One warm lamp in a dark room. Every surface in this interface sits somewhere in that light: the page is the unlit desk, a card is the paper under the lamp, a nested breakdown is the sheet on top of the stack. Surfaces get lighter as they get closer to the reader, and nothing is ever brighter than the light source itself. The accent color IS the lamp — one hue, chosen once by the user, used sparingly and always for the same purpose.

The whole shell is tinted clay (hue 45) rather than neutral gray. That single decision is where the warmth lives. PRODUCT.md is explicit that warmth comes from space and words, not decoration, so there is no gradient, no glow, no illustration, and no texture anywhere in this system. What makes it feel like a notebook instead of a bank is the temperature of the neutrals, the roominess of the spacing, and the plainness of the Spanish copy.

This system rejects the bank. No navy-and-gold trust theater, no enterprise dashboard chrome, no hero-metric block with a gradient behind the balance. It equally rejects the spreadsheet: line-item breakdowns are the product's reason to exist, so depth has to stay readable rather than collapsing into an undifferentiated grid. The interface is quiet so that one thing can be loud — the amount.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal shell, hue 45, dark-only. There is no light theme.
A three-step lightness ramp carries all depth; resting surfaces cast no shadow.
Five user-selectable accents, all at the same lightness band, all interchangeable without breaking a single contrast ratio.
Three fixed semantic colors for money in, money out, and pending. They never mean anything else.
Every monetary amount is monospaced. This is the system's signature.
Soft-edged and unhurried: 0.75-1rem radii, roomy padding, hairline borders, no visual pressure.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: One accent is active at a time, chosen by the user, applied identically everywhere. Never introduce a second accent for variety, never tint one screen differently, never hardcode a Tailwind palette color in a component. Every color passes through a token.

rules.name: The Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Semantic color is never the only signal. An expense is red AND carries a minus sign AND sits under a labeled section. A pending state is amber AND says 'Pendiente'. Strip the color out and the screen must still be readable.

rules.name: The Cold Room Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are hue 45. Not gray, not zinc, not slate. A neutral that reads cold has broken the system, and it will be visible the moment it sits next to a correct one.

rules.name: The Mono Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount is monospaced, without exception — a balance, a line item in a desglose, a savings target, a debt remainder. Tabular figures make columns of numbers scan vertically and stop digits from shifting as values update. A proportional amount anywhere in this app is a bug.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No tiny uppercase tracked kickers above sections. No 01 / 02 / 03 section numbering. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and the accent on headings. Uppercase appears nowhere in this system except inside user data.

rules.name: The Quiet Weight Rule
rules.body: Body text is 380, not 400. If text on this palette looks slightly heavy, the weight is wrong before the color is.

rules.name: The Three-Step Rule
rules.body: Depth is lightness for everything that sits in the page: Low Light → Lamp Surface → Lit Edge. A fourth step does not exist. If a layout seems to need one, the layout is wrong — most often it's a card nested inside a card, which is always an error. Use a well on Lit Edge instead.

rules.name: The Floating Exception
rules.body: Shadow marks only what leaves the page plane: active nav, modal, toast, dropdown. If it scrolls with the content, it gets no shadow. Cards, wells, inputs, notices, and tags are flat, permanently.

rules.name: The Audit Test
rules.body: Screenshot any screen and desaturate it. If you can still tell which surface is on top, the ramp is doing its job. If you can't, you reached for a shadow instead of a lightness step.

dos: Do route every color through a token. bg-surface-app, text-negative, border-border-strong — never bg-zinc-800 or text-rose-400.
Do monospace every monetary amount, everywhere, including inside breakdowns.
Do use .well on Lit Edge for nested desglose detail instead of nesting a card.
Do pair semantic color with a sign, label, or icon. Color is never the only carrier of meaning.
Do keep body text at weight 380 and let size and color carry hierarchy.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus state: 2px accent outline, 2px offset.
Do keep all five accents interchangeable. If a screen only works in Arena, the screen is broken.
Do write UI copy in Spanish, concise and utility-focused. Code, comments, and filenames stay English.
Do hold the contrast floors: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for interactive borders. Bone Faint on Lit Edge is already at 4.52:1 — there is no headroom left to spend.
donts: Don't use gradients, glowing highlights, or neon effects. Flat color is mandatory, carried over from the project skill file.
Don't build bank and fintech corporate: no navy-and-gold trust theater, no stock photography, no enterprise dashboard chrome.
Don't build a spreadsheet dump: walls of undifferentiated rows with no hierarchy. The breakdowns are the point, so they stay readable rather than becoming a grid.
Don't build a generic AI SaaS template: identical card grids, uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section, hero-metric blocks.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or notices. Full borders or none.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface. If it scrolls with the content, it is flat.
Don't nest a card inside a card. Ever.
Don't introduce a light theme, a fourth surface step, or a second accent color.
Don't reassign a semantic color. Green is money in, red is money out, amber is pending — in every screen, forever.
Don't use cheerful nagging, robotic filler, or labels that explain the obvious. PRODUCT.md is explicit: honest over reassuring.
Don't reach for a modal first. Exhaust inline and progressive alternatives before overlaying the task.
Don't ship a component with only a default state. Hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, and error are part of the component, not a follow-up.
